name: NestJS Boilerplate
description: Complete boilerplate for NestJS projects with Prisma ORM
highlights: Modular and scalable architecture with organized folder structure
Integrated Prisma ORM configuration with migrations and seeding
Generic base controllers, services, and repositories
Centralized app configuration and DTOs for pagination/responses
Production-ready setup with Swagger auto-documentation
Custom exception handling and decorators

name: FastAPI Template
description: Base template for creating fast, scalable APIs with FastAPI
highlights: JWT authentication integrated
SQLAlchemy async configuration with Alembic migrations
Pydantic schemas for data validation
Complete CRUD implementation with Repository pattern
Testing configuration with pytest
Docker and Docker Compose ready for deployment
Automatic documentation with Swagger UI and ReDoc

name: Ignix Core
description: TypeScript package for building type-safe, extensible services with Result pattern and ORM-agnostic repositories
highlights: Implements Result pattern for explicit success/failure handling, improving reliability
Provides generic services (IService<T>) with CRUD operations and customizable DTOs
ORM-agnostic repository interface supporting TypeORM, Prisma, and Sequelize
Framework-flexible API handlers with adapters for NestJS, Express, Fastify, and Hono
Promotes SOLID principles and type safety to reduce bugs and improve maintainability

name: FastAPI Generic Scaffold
description: A fully generic FastAPI scaffold architected with Screaming Architecture and Clean Architecture, featuring an automated scaffolding script that generates complete, production-ready modules — repository, service, and API layers — out of the box. The generic core is extensible through a Builder pattern, allowing custom wrappers at any layer, making it adaptable to virtually any backend domain. Includes a customizable built-in admin panel.
highlights: Architected with Screaming Architecture and Clean Architecture for domain-driven module organization
Automated scaffolding script generates ready-to-use modules with full repository, service, and API layers
Extensible core with Builder pattern for adding custom wrappers at repo, service, or controller level
Built-in customizable admin panel
Designed for adaptability across any backend domain

name: Educational Game-Based Learning Platform (Thesis)
description: A game-based educational platform designed to integrate with multiple video game types for programming learning. Features analytics dashboards to track student performance, course management, and teacher controls for customizing learning paths. Built with an adaptive architecture that enables seamless integration of diverse game genres while collecting and analyzing learning analytics in real time.
highlights: Multi-game integration architecture supporting diverse video game genres for programming education
Analytics dashboards for real-time student performance tracking and learning insights
Course management system with teacher-controlled adaptive learning paths
Scalable architecture designed for extensibility to new game types and analytics modules

name: hello-world-project
description: Starter template for new projects. Quick bootstrap with essential configurations and folder structure.
